stem: A metalworker has 400 grams of an alloy that is \(10\%\) tin by mass. The metalworker melts the alloy and adds 50 grams of pure tin. What percent of the new alloy is tin by mass?
solution: Tin at the start: \(0.10 \cdot 400 = 40\) grams. After adding: \(40 + 50 = 90\) grams of tin.
New total mass: \(400 + 50 = 450\) grams. Percent tin: \(\frac{90}{450} = 0.20 = 20\%\).
verify:
ans = Rational(Rational(10, 100)*400 + 50, 400 + 50) * 100
assert ans == 20
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
